GitHub is the public code mirror. Please submit this change as a GitLab merge
request in the source project, following [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
Review, required CI and merges take place in GitLab.

## Problem and resulting behavior
Explain the trigger and the behavior after this change.

## Validation
State the relevant checks and their actual results. Explain skipped checks.

## Compatibility and delivery
Describe configuration, persistence, migration and recovery effects. For a bundled
System/Wizard change, identify the tested Wizard source and gitlink relationship.

- [ ] Required CI gates remain enabled.
- [ ] Documentation and relevant checks match the resulting behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, private configuration or unrelated logs are included.
- [ ] Third-party licenses/notices are preserved.

Merge does not authorize Production promotion. Use the documented delivery tools.
